title: jwt authentication and tiered access control
description: Verify that the JWT-based authentication system correctly authenticates users and enforces tiered access control across personal, workspace, and administrative routes.

title: ai driven strategic report generation
description: Test the AI-driven strategic report generation to ensure it synthesizes enterprise data into insightful narratives highlighting anomalies and root causes without restating obvious metrics.

title: automated data forensics and cleaning
description: Validate the automated data forensics and cleaning engine for anomaly detection, null handling, and first-principles validation with full audit trails and irreversible backups.

title: dynamic ai suggested dashboard generation
description: Ensure AI-suggested dashboards dynamically generate visualizations based on dataset semantics and business goals, adhering to visualization best practices without placeholder data.

title: synthetic data generation with ai assistance
description: Test the AI-powered synthetic data generation feature to produce realistic mock datasets that do not compromise real data integrity or security.

title: conversational analyst natural language queries
description: Verify the Conversational Analyst copilot supports natural language queries for dataset exploration and report modification without requiring SQL expertise.

title: fraud proof data and dashboard modification tracking
description: Validate that all changes to data, dashboards, and reports are tracked with audit trails and version control to ensure traceability and fraud prevention.

title: predictive scheduling and automated reporting
description: Test the predictive scheduling and automated reporting system to ensure meetings are only created when necessary, with AI-generated voice-narrated video reports and proactive notification intercepts.

title: system resilience under high concurrency
description: Verify the system maintains low latency and stable, resilient operations under high concurrency and load, supporting organizational flow without race conditions or errors.

title: strict security enforcement across all routes
description: Ensure strict security enforcement via JWT authentication and tiered access control across all user, workspace, and admin routes without regressions.
